title: AI Model Rankings
subtitle: Model rankings from public evaluations
headline: A clearer view of model performance.
intro: Compare selected models using public results from Artificial Analysis, LiveBench and Arena on a shared ranking scale.
snapshotHint: Public results as retrieved. The retrieval date is not the evaluation date.
compositeHint: Equal-weight average of available source rank percentiles within the selected models, out of 100.
methodologyIntro: Scores from three public sources are converted to relative ranks, then available results are combined for each model.
methodologySteps: Each source ranks selected models with results from that source, highest original score first, using average ranks for ties. Percentile = (model count − rank) ÷ (model count − 1) × 100. The composite is the equal-weight average of available source percentiles, without filling missing results with zero, rounded to two decimals. Equal composite scores share a rank.
methodologyScope: Model details show coverage of 2/3 or 3/3 sources. Source coverage and test configurations affect comparability. This is a reference for the selected models, not an official global ranking, and does not measure price or speed.
methodologyConfig: For each model, the highest-scoring published configuration is used from each source. Reasoning effort and tools can differ between sources; exact configurations appear in model details.
methodologyDates: Data retrieved on {{date}}. Source release dates are listed below. Retrieval dates are not evaluation dates.
methodologyExclusions: Models require comparable results from at least two sources. Missing results appear as —. Coding agents, image-generation rankings and models with only one source are excluded.
sourceDescription: This ranking combines public results from the three sources below. Visit each source to verify original results and test conditions.
footer: Composite scores express relative rank among selected models, not accuracy. Consider source coverage and test configurations when comparing results.
